issues_found.description: ORD-03: sweepStalledCorrelations predicate is `p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq` (missing + 1) — a slow-but-present correlation (lowest PENDING seq = applied_seq+1) is wrongly dead-lettered. TC-ORD-03-AC5-non-stalled-not-swept fails. IMPLEMENTATION defect, correctly surfaced by fail-first test; route to BACKEND-DEV. Fix: `p.lowest_seq > c.applied_seq + 1`.

DDL-04 AC5: runBackfill executes `if (rows_updated == 0) break;` BEFORE the stall check, so the ten-consecutive-zero-progress stall policy is unreachable; a stuck backfill terminates with stalled=false/status=applied. TC-DDL-04-AC5-stall-escalation fails. IMPLEMENTATION defect, correctly surfaced by fail-first test; route to BACKEND-DEV.

VLD-04: runSemanticGate's finding-producing path corrupts heap memory — persistVerdict writes a garbage compiler_version on findings and TC-VLD-04-AC3-stale-verdict-reruns / TC-VLD-04-AC4-timeout segfault. IMPLEMENTATION defect (root cause in the validateDefinition finding path); route to BACKEND-DEV/ISSUE-FIXER.

The 3 schema-contract suites (ddl04_plat_migration_state_test.zig, obp04_plat_outbox_gate_test.zig, vld04_definition_semantic_verdict_test.zig — BACKEND-DEV codegen artefacts) use static fixture IDs (e.g. 'ddl04-mig-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') rather than per-test UUIDs. Isolation is nonetheless guaranteed because they run on TestHarness (rollback-on-deinit transaction), so this is a style/letter-of-rule deviation only, not a leakage risk. No action required unless the convention is tightened.

Pipeline checks (6)-(10) are N/A for this batch: DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04 are backend-only requirements with no sequential-UI-action surface — no web/tests/e2e/pipelines file references them, so no pl.step()/onCleanup()/PIPELINE-<slug>.md is required.
